name: Shenzhen Kingkey Smart Agriculture Times Co.,Ltd
summary: Shenzhen Kingkey Smart Agriculture Times Co.,Ltd engages in the real estate and breeding businesses in China. The company is involved in pig breeding and sales; feed production and sales; breeding and sales of breeder chickens and broiler chickens; research and development, production, and sales of pig feed, chicken feed, and aquatic feed; improved breed breeding; pig slaughtering; and meat product packaging, refrigeration and transportation. It also provides real estate development, property leasing, and smart community services.
